authority.odaSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
roles: entry count is a BL in the object data body
ordered sort handles are H code 0 in the body stream
block owner and ordered entity handles are H code 4 in the object handle stream

bitCoordinateFrame.meaning: Cursor positions in decoded object-local body and handle buffers. Body and handle-stream bounds are distinct domains; offsets are not compressed source-file byte positions.
bitCoordinateFrame.name: objectDecompressedBitstreamBits

implementation.change: Add a disabled-by-default internal diagnostic switch. When the in-tree inventory enables it, SORTENTSTABLE parsing records object-buffer cursor intervals and emits one row only after successful parsing. Optional allocation/formatting failure does not fail the DWG parse. The audit rejects missing/duplicate profiles, wrong ordinals/targets, zero-width or overlapping fields, count/body boundary errors, and handle-stream boundary/order errors.

independentValuePeer.comparison: All 16 table identities, owner values, entry counts, ordered entity/sort values, and parser-enforced handle roles agree; peer provides no independent field bit offsets.
independentValuePeer.name: LibreDWG minJSON

limits: Intervals are observed by libdxfrw itself; no independent implementation reports matching physical bit offsets.
Coordinates are in separate decoded object-local body and handle buffers, not compressed source-file byte positions.
Peer equality proves decoded values/order and peer schema roles, not correctness of the parser-observed offsets.
This does not prove recursive target closure, strict source-wide output, producer prevalence, or native draw-order semantics.
The 657 other AC1021 frames without exhaustive body-reference decoding remain unqualified.
